{{Top|leg}}
A '''signal wand''' was a quarter-meter-long stick that had multiple functions, the most popular being transmitting a tight-beam signal beyond a [[Planet/Legends|planet's]] gravity well. It had a red light that could be used to transmit visual codes. A new signal wand cost 300 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]].
